title: Electrical energy consumed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly calculated as 1.08 × 10⁵ J.

title: Output power calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly calculated as 350 W.

title: Internal resistance value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly calculated as 0.1 Ω.

title: Force equilibrium at max speed
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law, stating traction force equals the total resistive force at maximum speed.

title: Resistive force calculation
description: Important: The resistive force must be correctly calculated as 0.05 times the total weight of the rider and bicycle.

title: Power balance for motor
description: Important: The solution must use the conservation of power: electrical input power equals output mechanical power plus thermal power loss.

title: Joule heating formula
description: Important: The thermal power loss must be correctly expressed as I²r.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations should maintain consistent SI units (kg, m, s, J, W, Ω).

title: Incorrect force or power formula
description: Pitfall: Using P = Fv with an incorrect force (e.g., using weight instead of resistive force) or incorrect speed.

title: Sign or factor error in resistance
description: Pitfall: Misapplying the 0.05 factor (e.g., using 0.5) or miscalculating the total mass (rider + bicycle).
